# E0346: value parameter that nothing determines

A call writes no value arguments, so a value parameter is found from the types of the arguments or of the result. Use it in one of them, as in `array.Array<i64, n>`.

- Rule: [`generics.value-parameters-determined`](../../reference/07-types.md#generics.value-parameters-determined)
- Reported at: the value parameter.
- Tier: `meta`, checked in the `items` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0346:1
fn zeros<n: i64>() -> i64 { n }
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
use std.array

fn count<n: i64>(a: array.Array<i64, n>) -> i64 { n }
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0346_value_parameter_that_nothing_determines.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0346_value_parameter_that_nothing_determines.lt):

```text
── VALUE PARAMETER THAT NOTHING DETERMINES ── E0346_value_parameter_that_nothing_determines.lt:1:10  [E0346]

`n` appears in no parameter's type and not in the result type, so no call
determines it:

  1 │ fn zeros<n: i64>() -> i64 { n }
    │          ^^^^^^

A call writes no value arguments, so a value parameter is found from the types
of the arguments or of the result. Use it in one of them, as in
`array.Array<i64, n>`.
```
